criteria.observation: Uses matched pre/post windows and identifies the observed change in customer-facing latency with attributable source evidence.
Uses comparable observations to explain why a leading mechanism fits better than a credible competitor.
Separates incident association, local mechanism evidence and unresolved operational causality or effect size.
Specifies differing predictions and which conclusion would change if the result contradicts the leading explanation.
A second operator can reproduce the selected comparison from its inputs, controlled conditions, observable measurement and stop boundary.
